apps/worker/src/index.ts.name: Worker entry
apps/worker/src/index.ts.description: Boots the worker: pool, realtime, run runtime, Graphile hosts, reconciler, health and shutdown handling.

apps/worker/src/health.ts.name: Worker health file
apps/worker/src/health.ts.description: Writes a heartbeat file every 30 seconds that the Docker healthcheck reads to detect a dead worker.

apps/api/src/index.ts.name: API entry
apps/api/src/index.ts.description: Starts the Hono server, optional inbound-only listener, websocket upgrade and drain-aware shutdown.

apps/api/src/app.ts.name: API composition
apps/api/src/app.ts.description: Builds the API app: foundation, RunStarter, job publisher, run runtime, reconciler and a stop that hands runs back.

apps/api/src/http/health.ts.name: API health routes
apps/api/src/http/health.ts.description: Serves /health, /ready with a database probe, and private-network /internal/health.

apps/api/src/http/drain.ts.name: Connection drain
apps/api/src/http/drain.ts.description: Defines the SIGUSR2 run-drain signal and closes streams and sockets first on a deploy.

apps/api/src/threads/thread-target.ts.name: Send message flow
apps/api/src/threads/thread-target.ts.description: Writes a user message, steers or answers a waiting run, or creates a queued run in one transaction.

apps/api/src/routes/threads.ts.name: Thread routes
apps/api/src/routes/threads.ts.description: Serves thread RPCs and the cursor-based event stream with heartbeats and peer or background filtering.

apps/api/src/auth/user-devices.ts.name: Device socket routes
apps/api/src/auth/user-devices.ts.description: Pairs desktop devices and accepts their websocket, with a forward path between API processes.

apps/desktop/src/main/this-computer/nati.name: Desktop native stack
apps/desktop/src/main/this-computer/nati.description: Launches a local API and worker on the desktop with Graphile wakeups and the Pi runtime.

packages/adapters/src/runs/wakeups/run-w.name: Run starter and scanner
packages/adapters/src/runs/wakeups/run-w.description: Starts due runs in process, hands them over on runs:ready, and rescans every 5 seconds to recover dead ones.

packages/adapters/src/runs/wakeups/wakeu.name: Graphile job layer
packages/adapters/src/runs/wakeups/wakeu.description: Publishes and runs Graphile jobs in interactive, background and maintenance hosts, and prunes dead jobs.

packages/adapters/src/runs/wakeups/wake-.name: Run wake nudge
packages/adapters/src/runs/wakeups/wake-.description: Nudges a committed run to start now or later, logging instead of failing when the nudge is lost.

packages/adapters/src/runs/wakeups/job-r.name: Leader reconciler
packages/adapters/src/runs/wakeups/job-r.description: Repairs stuck runs, bot outcomes and routine wakes every 30 seconds under a Postgres advisory-lock leader.

packages/adapters/src/runs/wakeups/backg.name: Job handlers
packages/adapters/src/runs/wakeups/backg.description: Dispatches typed background jobs and re-enters the owning tenant for each job's row.

packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.name: Run attempt and heartbeat
packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.description: Finds a continuable run, claims it, renews its lease every 60 seconds and aborts when the lease is lost.

packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.name: Run claim and requeue
packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.description: Claims runs under a fence, renews leases, computes retry delays and requeues interrupted or failed-setup runs.

packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.name: Run admission
packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.description: Admits runs by free memory and heap headroom rather than a fixed run count, and tracks active runs.

packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.name: Recovery blockers
packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.description: Finds runs blocked by another run's computer lease and expires abandoned takeover holds.

packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.name: Run failure handling
packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.description: Maps run errors to user text and decides requeue, routine retry, backoff or pause.

packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/stu.name: Stuck work reconciler
packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/stu.description: Notifies and expires queued or takeover-waiting runs that sit untouched past the configured age.

packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.name: Approved effect replay
packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.description: Orders and replays approved external effects when a paused run resumes after approval.

packages/adapters/src/runs/executor/exec.name: Run executor
packages/adapters/src/runs/executor/exec.description: Drives continueRun: find, claim, hold, assemble, run the turn, retry setup and release in order.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.name: Run runtime wiring
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.description: Defines runtime env settings and builds connectors, executor and job handlers shared by API and worker.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.name: Routine wake logic
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.description: Turns a due routine into a run after staleness, owner and watch checks, advancing its next time.

packages/adapters/src/runs/turn/run-turn.name: Turn pause for input
packages/adapters/src/runs/turn/run-turn.description: Saves the turn checkpoint and moves a run to waiting_input when the agent asks the user.

packages/adapters/src/runs/turn/turn-che.name: Turn checkpoint format
packages/adapters/src/runs/turn/turn-che.description: Defines the versioned saved transcript used to resume a paused or handed-back turn.

packages/adapters/src/runs/turn/tool-loo.name: Tool loop guard
packages/adapters/src/runs/turn/tool-loo.description: Stops a run that repeats the same tool call or exceeds the action limits.

packages/adapters/src/notifications/real.name: Postgres realtime
packages/adapters/src/notifications/real.description: Fans out topic signals through pg_notify and one LISTEN connection with reconnect and an in-memory variant.

packages/adapters/src/server/server-foun.name: Server foundation
packages/adapters/src/server/server-foun.description: Starts the secret store, security stores, content keys and thread events the same way in API and worker.

packages/adapters/src/messaging/bot-mess.name: Bot to bot messages
packages/adapters/src/messaging/bot-mess.description: Delivers a message between bots as one transaction that creates the target's run, with hops and replay keys.

packages/adapters/src/routines/strategic.name: Daily initiative check-in
packages/adapters/src/routines/strategic.description: Creates a daily check-in run per bot from stale scratchpad items, restricted to safe tools.

packages/adapters/src/tasks/ticket-wake..name: Ticket assignee wake
packages/adapters/src/tasks/ticket-wake..description: Creates a silent run that wakes a ticket's current assignee bot.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/usage/p.name: Pi usage normalizer
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/usage/p.description: Normalizes provider token and cost data from model calls into one usage record shape.

packages/adapters/src/computers/computer.name: Computer lifecycle
packages/adapters/src/computers/computer.description: Defines computer execution leases, their 5-minute length, acquisition, renewal and release.

packages/core/src/runs/run-state.ts.name: Run state machine
packages/core/src/runs/run-state.ts.description: Defines run statuses, legal transitions, terminal and waiting sets, and which triggers count as conversational.

packages/core/src/runs/stuck-work.ts.name: Stuck work thresholds
packages/core/src/runs/stuck-work.ts.description: Sets the 4-hour notify and 24-hour expire ages for waiting runs, overridable by environment.

packages/core/src/bots/bot-messages.ts.name: Bot message hops
packages/core/src/bots/bot-messages.ts.description: Caps bot-to-bot message chains at 100 hops and tells when the cap is reached.

packages/db/src/database/row-security.ts.name: Row security context
packages/db/src/database/row-security.ts.description: Holds the tenant or system database context that Postgres row-level security policies read.

packages/db/src/threads/events.ts.name: Thread event log
packages/db/src/threads/events.ts.description: Appends sequenced thread events under the thread lock and finalizes runs with fenced writes.

packages/db/src/threads/event-stream.ts.name: Event stream follower
packages/db/src/threads/event-stream.ts.description: Streams thread events after a cursor, using realtime signals only as a wake-up latch.

packages/db/src/runs/run-turn-checkpoint.name: Checkpoint storage
packages/db/src/runs/run-turn-checkpoint.description: Stores the saved turn transcript as a reserved external-effect row, encrypted per space.

packages/adapter-kit/src/registry.ts.name: Adapter registry
packages/adapter-kit/src/registry.ts.description: Declares the adapter slots and a registry for runtime, sandbox, jobs, realtime and other swappable parts.

packages/adapter-kit/src/background-jobs.name: Background job types
packages/adapter-kit/src/background-jobs.description: Validates job payloads and builds typed jobs such as run.continue, routine.wakeup and messaging.send.

packages/adapter-kit/src/interfaces.ts.name: Adapter interfaces
packages/adapter-kit/src/interfaces.ts.description: Defines shared interfaces including JobPublisher, JobWorkerHost and queue order contracts.

packages/logging/src/axiom.ts.name: Root logger setup
packages/logging/src/axiom.ts.description: Builds the service logger with optional Axiom and Sentry sinks chosen from environment variables.
